permissions.note: Permission requirements need endpoint-specific official confirmation. Requested scopes in source code are not evidence of grants.

api.pagination_plan: Keep Business Discovery field expansion on the authenticated source IG user; use the returned media cursor; do not fetch third-party media IDs as owned media; stop at 30 unique posts or error.
api.token_transport_if_later_validated: Authorization header; never report token, proof, cursor or request URL containing secrets.

result.empty_fields_reason: No authorized eligible source has been verified; null means not observed, not zero.

error_taxonomy.no_publications: Only a successful eligible response with media_count=0 can support this conclusion; an empty filtered page alone cannot.
error_taxonomy.no_caption: Only a returned media object without a nonempty caption; separate field absent, null and empty.
error_taxonomy.insufficient_permission: Verified missing required grants or a relevant Meta permission error; not inferred from missing credentials.
error_taxonomy.ineligible_account: Verified unsupported auth flow/account type, missing Page link, or explicit eligibility response; ambiguous object errors remain inconclusive.
error_taxonomy.expired_token: Meta debug_token expiration/validity evidence or explicit expiry subcode (e.g. 190/463); code 190 alone is invalid/revoked/expired ambiguity.
error_taxonomy.api_error: Other Meta failures, unsupported fields/version, rate limiting or malformed response; retain only numeric code/subcode, safe type and HTTP status.
error_taxonomy.environment_blocked: Prerequisite unavailable before Graph API request; no fabricated HTTP or Meta code.

recommendations.text: The Facebook Login provider is the candidate route for this experiment. No evidence from this environment proves that Business Discovery works for wesleydolse on v25.0.
No production connection, OAuth, refresh, deployment, configuration or record change was performed. Do not infer production eligibility from this local checkout.

Use an already authorized read-only access path to the intended environment. Select one explicit existing integration and tenant; verify actual token type/validity, granted scopes and the Page-to-professional-IG link before calling the target. Do not request tokens through chat or create new OAuth grants.

saveProviderPage stores a Page token in Integration.token and the IG user ID in internalId. Page ID, IG user ID and Facebook user ID must not be interchanged. Verify the original Facebook user-token context rather than assuming the publication token is eligible.

Keep tenant-specific authorization and token isolation. Require the appropriate reviewed access level/app mode for external clients; validate that status in Meta before rollout. A provider scope array is not proof of Advanced Access or granted permissions.

Treat professional-account coverage and returned captions as explicit limits. For each client, track cursor progress, deduplication, API rate-limit headers, token validity and missing captions. Do not promise monitoring of arbitrary personal accounts or complete keyword coverage.

Keep this as an isolated diagnostic until at least one real caption and permalink are obtained through the approved Graph route, followed by a multiclient permission/quota review. Do not change the existing login or publishing flows to run this test.

configuration_evidence_note: Only names and presence states are recorded. Missing app credentials in this local environment do not prove absence in production or absence of tokens in the database.
